PASS with real caveats -- read before use. (1) RESPONSE LEVELS DO NOT MATCH THE INSTRUMENT: the live table carries five resp levels (0,1,2,3,4; level 4 is used by 15-62 of 689 respondents on every one of the 21 items, ~5% overall) while both the paper ("Seven items are rated on a 4-point Likert scale ranging from 0 (did not apply to me) to 3 (applied to me very much)") and the Musa Bahasa Malaysia DASS-21 form ("bulatkan pada nombor 0,1,2 atau 3") document a four-point 0-3 scale. Summing the seven items per subscale WITH level 4 counted as 4 reproduces the paper's own Table 2 subscale SDs to <=0.02, so level 4 is a real, analysed response level and not a missing-value code -- the administration evidently offered a fifth option that neither the paper nor the form describes. Consequence: NO option_text is shipped (all five levels blank) and NO instructions are shipped, because the only published anchor set and the only published instruction paragraph both describe a 0-3 ladder that demonstrably is not the one respondents used. Nothing was padded or guessed.
